title: Orthodontic Benefit Riders Claims Manual — Carried Benefit and the First Payment at the New Practice
content:
**Orthodontic Benefit Riders: amount of the first payment on a case that has moved.**

## Case benefit, unpaid case benefit and carried benefit

1. **Case benefit.** The case benefit follows the benefit rule of the rider.
   - Start from the allowed case fee on the latest establishment entry, less the part of the rider's lifetime orthodontic deductible not yet used by the person.
   - Multiply by the rider coinsurance for the network status on that entry, and round half up to the cent.
   - For a takeover entry, that amount is then prorated by the months remaining divided by the planned treatment months on that entry, and rounded half up to the cent. The exception is a takeover entry that supersedes a new-start entry of the same case, whose fee already covers only the treatment from the start of coverage.
   - The result is limited to the rider's lifetime maximum less the payments, net of reversals, made under the rider for other cases.
2. **Deductible not yet used.** This is:
   - the whole deductible, when every establishment entry under the rider carries the case's case number;
   - the deductible less the allowed case fees on the establishment entries of the other cases, when those add up to less than the deductible;
   - nothing, otherwise.
3. **Unpaid case benefit.** The case benefit less every initial and installment payment on the case, net of reversals, rounded half up to the cent and never below zero.
4. **Carried benefit.** The unpaid case benefit, with one exception. When the recognised remaining-treatment fee on the latest transfer entry is lower than the unpaid case benefit divided by the rider coinsurance for that entry's network status, the carried benefit is the coinsurance share of that fee, rounded half up to the cent. With no transfer entry on the case, the carried benefit is the unpaid case benefit.
5. **Installments left on the original schedule.** Take the planned treatment months after the banding month, limit them to the rider's installment months cap, divide by the service-period length (one month, or three on a quarterly schedule) and round up. Subtract the installment payments on the case that have not been reversed. The result is never fewer than one.
6. **The payment.** The carried benefit is spread evenly over the installments left on the original schedule. The first carried payment covers one service period and is one such share, rounded half up to the cent.

## Order of assembly

The first carried payment is assembled in one fixed order:

1. Every ratio that applies to the unpaid case benefit is applied first. The product is rounded half up to the cent and limited to the rider's lifetime maximum less every payment, net of reversals, made under the rider.
2. The carried benefit then follows from that amount.
3. Every amount taken off the carried benefit comes off next, never below zero.
4. Every percentage held back comes off the rest.
5. The remainder is divided by the number of payments it is spread over, and rounded half up to the cent.
6. That share, times the service periods the first carried payment covers, is rounded half up to the cent to give the payment.

## Which case

- The case is the one whose establishment entry is the latest establishment entry under the rider.
- Its payments and transfer entries are those carrying its case number.
- The latest transfer entry is the one with the latest date. When two entries of one kind carry the same date, the one entered first counts as the latest.
- A rider with no establishment entry has no case to carry, and its first carried payment is zero.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

The case:

- new-start, in-network establishment entry with an allowed case fee of 5,340.00;
- hypothetical coinsurance of 50 percent, no deductible, a hypothetical lifetime maximum of 3,000.00, and no other cases;
- planned for 24 months on a monthly schedule with a 24-month cap;
- 9 installments issued and not reversed, and payments on the case of 1,187.40 net.

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Case benefit | 5,340.00 times 50 percent is 2,670.00 |
| Unpaid case benefit | 2,670.00 less 1,187.40 is 1,482.60 |
| Latest transfer entry: in network, recognised fee 3,410.00 | 3,410.00 is not lower than 1,482.60 divided by 50 percent (2,965.20), so the carried benefit is 1,482.60 |
| Installments left | 23 months after the banding month give 23 installments; less 9 issued, 14 left |
| First carried payment | 1,482.60 divided by 14 is 105.90 |
| Same case, recognised fee 2,500.00 instead | carried benefit is 50 percent of 2,500.00, which is 1,250.00; the payment is 1,250.00 divided by 14, which is 89.2857, rounded to 89.29 |
